items.myth: Wahan pahunchte hi job mil jaati hai
items.fact: Job dhundhne mein time lagta hai
items.detail: Pehle kuch mahine ka kharcha apne budget se plan karo.

items.myth: Part-time se poori fees nikal jaayegi
items.fact: Part-time ek support hai, plan nahi
items.detail: Fees aur rent ka plan pehle se banao. Job se bas madad milti hai.

items.myth: Kaam ke hours ki koi limit nahi
items.fact: Har country ke apne rules hain
items.detail: Student visa ke work rules pehle padho, aur unhe follow karo.

youtube.title: Abroad mein part-time job easy hai? Myth vs Fact
youtube.description:
Part-time job ke 3 bade myths. Job milne mein time lagta hai, part-time se poori fees nahi nikalti, aur har country ke student visa ke apne work rules hain. Pehle padho, phir plan karo.
